scope: Supplemental read-only probe requested after the parent questioned DSEM-CONTROL-GROUPING-003. No source, tests, Git, network, connector, Vault or human-gate mutation. The original R2 artifact is preserved byte-for-byte; this supplement corrects the control-group determination.

finding_correction.reason: Appending a newly sealed control with round=e1 to an unchanged graph containing completed events e1 and e2 is rejected because deterministic replay changes the expected event-2 child set/control head; the observed result is DISCOVERY_GRAPH_INVALID. Re-sealing event2 with that control head is a distinct valid history in which the control existed before event2, and is not evidence of stale append acceptance.
finding_correction.contract_interpretation: The combination of control_before_event(), complete_projections() event.control_head sealing, stored-event equality, and complete child checks supplies the R3 grouping boundary without filesystem mtime or a hidden global clock. A control with round=e1 can legitimately precede event2; an append after an unchanged event2 cannot.

probe.method: The probe creates two complete one-request rounds in isolated /private/tmp checkouts. Scenario 1 seals a new user_stop control with sequence 1 and round=e1, then constructs Graph over the unchanged two-event document set. Scenario 2 installs user_stop and resume after e1 through the public control path, completes e2, and replays the resulting valid history.

observed.error_message: complete event is missing a required exact child

result: The control-group finding is not an actual implementation defect and must not block acceptance. The frontier-conflict finding remains the only open actual finding from the original three-module review; the parent changed discovery_plan.py after the original snapshot, so the current plan hash is recorded separately above.
